profile.summary: Accomplished backend developer with experience developing business-oriented web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and SQL Server. Skilled in designing secure RESTful APIs, implementing authentication and authorization, and translating real-world business workflows into reliable, maintainable backend systems. Committed to continuous learning and practical projects.

project_evidence: Led a team of six developers to define backend architecture, establish coding standards, and coordinate development across five business modules. Designed and implemented JWT‑based authentication and RBAC for four operational roles, securing 60+ REST endpoints. Developed the Waiter module with order creation, reservation management, and table availability validation. Collaborated with frontend developers on UI workflows and API integration.

Developed the Admin module for an English e‑learning platform, centralizing course, lesson, user, and coupon management. Integrated backend services with a React‑based admin interface using API‑first development, leveraging Cursor and Claude to accelerate implementation.
